E0202

The write-access marker `&` is required at call site — write access not granted

What

The write-access marker `&` is required at call site — write access not granted

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Add the write-access marker `&` at the call site.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0202: tests/ui/iter_cursor_immutable_binding.stderr.

Error [E0202]: Cannot write to `cur` — it does not have the write-access marker `&`; required before calling `.next()`
  --> tests/ui/iter_cursor_immutable_binding.jet:20:15
    |
 20 |     a :: &cur.next()
    |               ^^^^
 Why: This method edits the value it's called on; the write-access marker `&` is required
 Fix: Declare `cur := ...`
